work.text: Imagine his despair if foul biting had ruined his months of labor on the Fair at Impruneta, [into which he had packed] 1138 people, 45 horses, 67 donkeys, and 137 dogs, marshaling this [multitude] between diagonal lanes of bare ground that avoid the older presentation of a crowd as a bumper crop of pumpkins.

moment.text: Callot dedicated this print to the Grand Duke of Tuscany, for whom the fair signified a healthy Florentine economy.

matters.text: The annual fair held in Impruneta, a commune in Florence, Italy, was an opportunity for rural and urban communities to comingle and partake in commerce, socializing, and festivity.
Pick-pocketing, fighting, snake-charming, and the punishment of a criminal by torture also occur.
